items.label: MA-AG civil: Pinnacle Financial Consulting, LLC
items.detail: Final judgment in Suffolk Superior Court against a Lawrence foreclosure rescue and legal services company for predatory practices and unauthorized practice of law; date is the announcement date (judgment entered 2015-03-17). Stated as $1.9 million, being $1.2 million restitution plus $665,000 civil penalties, with more than $55,000 in fees and costs on top (not added); owner Robert Burton is jointly ordered and left out; litigated judgment so admission is blank. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2015-pinnacle-financial-consulting; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: From the row note (release read 2026-10-10): "more than $55,000 in fees and costs on top (not added)". Counted: the stated $1.9 million. Update 2026-10-11 (shared total): the $1.9 million judgment orders the company and its owner Robert Burton to pay together ('Pinnacle and Burton are ordered to pay the Commonwealth $1.9 million'), with no split stated, so it is counted for no company (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2015-pinnacle-financial-consulting, data/manual/shared-allocations.csv); not counted is that $1.9 million plus the more than $55,000 in fees and costs.
